tasks.title: Serve GET …/scm/code-search from an index at its head
steps: Write the tests of the search's answer, its limits, its refusals, the partial index and the feature off in internal/codeindex, and confirm they fail

Serve GET /workspaces/:slug/scm/code-search and GET /workspaces/:slug/scm/symbols with the scope and read mark of the source control reads, bounded by [scm].read_timeout and reported under the ops code_search and symbols, which the catalogue's documented values gain; until task 2 the symbols handler answers the checks the two routes share and nothing else

Write the checks the two routes share once, in the PRD's order: the feature (404 code_index_disabled), the parameters (400), the setting (409 code_index_off), the head (the tree route's error for a workspace without one); at this task a request whose index is not at the head is answered 503 code_index_not_ready with state building, which task 3 replaces with the wait
Read q (1 to 500 characters, at most 1,024 bytes, not blank) and limit (1 to 25, default 20)

Ask the index through its code_search tool (Index.Tools, Execute) with query, max_files the limit and context_lines 0, under the request's context; map invalid_arguments with a parse error to 400 invalid_query with the parser's message, search_failed for its timeout and aborted to 503 scm_timeout, and any other error to the hub's internal error

Build the answer from the tool's data: files in its order, language from outline.LangFor of the path, matches the lines marked as matches in line order, at most 20, text cut to 500 characters; truncated and partial as the tool reports them; workspace and indexed_sha from the component's record
Describe the route and its errors in docs/api.md

tasks.title: Serve GET …/scm/symbols
steps: Write the tests of the lookup, its narrowing and its refusals, and the tables over both routes of the setting off, the access rule and the workspace without a head, in internal/codeindex, and confirm they fail
Read name (1 to 200 characters), exact (a boolean), kind (one of the declaration kinds, lower-cased), path (checked as the source control reads check a path, optional) and limit (1 to 50, default 20)
Ask the index with Index.Symbols; where path names a file, ask for its directory and keep the matches of that file, unless the index takes a file itself
When the index does not answer: 409 code_index_partial with indexed_sha for a partial index, 422 too_many_matches otherwise for a built index
Answer the matches in the index's order cut to limit, each without the index's backend member, with truncated, workspace, indexed_sha and partial false
Describe the route in docs/api.md

tasks.title: Wait for the index of the arrival head
steps: Write the tests of the wait, the queued build, the timeout, the failed build, the race of searches against commits and the metric in internal/codeindex, and confirm they fail

Read the head of the default branch when the request arrives; when the record is at it, answer; otherwise make sure a build is pending with the component's enqueue function of package 59 and wait for the record to change, woken by the build's settlement and not by polling the store
Accept an index at the arrival head or at a head the default branch reached after it: after each build compare the record with the arrival head and with the branch's current head

When the request's context ends at the read timeout while it waits, answer 503 code_index_not_ready with Retry-After: 5, state building, head_sha and indexed_sha; the read wrapper's own 503 scm_timeout must not replace it
When the last build of the head failed and no attempt is running, answer 503 code_index_not_ready at once with state failed and Retry-After the seconds until the job's next attempt, at least 1
Hold the index open for the length of the query, so that a build that replaces it meanwhile closes the old one only after the query ended

Add parley_code_index_wait_seconds, a histogram with the label outcome, to the catalogue and to the counts its tests and test/e2e/metrics_test.go assert, and observe it once per request that reached the rule

tasks.title: Search a fork through its parent, and tag the answers
steps: Write the tests of the fork and of the entity tags in internal/codeindex, and confirm they fail
For a fork, after the access check on the fork itself, take the parent's setting, head, record and index for every later step, and answer workspace as the parent's slug

Once the waiting rule is satisfied, give the answer its ETag from the indexed commit, the route and the query's parameters, and the caching headers of a read to revalidate, with the helpers of internal/scm where they can be used from here; answer 304 before the index is asked
Leave every refusal without ETag and with the caching headers the source control reads give an error
Describe the fork rule and the caching in docs/api.md and the two routes in the code index part of docs/architecture.md
